newsitem.title: USA: Mobil completes natgas processing sale.
newsitem.headline: Mobil completes natgas processing sale.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Tuesday it has completed the sale of its equity interests in its U.S.-based natural gas gathering and processing operations to PanEnergy Corp for about $300 million in cash.
With the completion of this sale, Mobil's production of natural gas liquids in the U.S. will decline by about 25,000 barrels per day, the company said.
The sale was closed in two steps, Mobil said.
In August, the company received about $200 million for most of the facilities it owned outright.
The latest and final closing represents two remaining Mobil-owned plants and facilities where the sale of Mobil's equity interests required approval by Mobil's partners, the company explained.
